structured_output.title: Track: Hay Loop
structured_output.summary: Add a third registered track, `src/content/tracks/hay-loop.json` ("Hay Loop", 3 laps, width 11), as pure JSON using only the existing prop kinds. It is a long dirt ribbon shaped like the S6 thumbnail: a straight start, a wavy S-bend, and a tight teardrop hairpin loop at the far end whose legs don't cross. The back straight has one ramp. Hay bale rows line the inside of the hairpin, tyre stacks its outside, and cone trees fill the infield. The bot laps it in about 52 s. Its file name sorts after `bends` and `dust-bowl`, so Bramble Bends stays first on the menu and Hay Loop follows Dust Bowl in the NEXT RACE order. No sim, bot, render or UI code changes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The track registry includes a track with id "hay-loop", name "Hay Loop", 3 laps and width at least 11, which passes track validation. Bramble Bends is still first in the registry. The next track after "dust-bowl" is "hay-loop", and the next after "hay-loop" wraps back to "bends".

Hay Loop's built layout is 1000–1400 units long. Somewhere on the dense centreline the heading turns at least 150° in one direction within 50 units of lap distance (the hairpin). Elsewhere, a turn of at least 40° one way is followed within 120 units by a turn of at least 40° the other way (the S-bend).

Hay Loop's ribbon never overlaps itself: any two layout centreline points more than 60 units apart along the lap are at least width + 2 units apart in the world. The track has exactly one ramp, with its lip between 35% and 65% of the lap (the back straight).

On Hay Loop, a single bot finishes all 3 laps for each test seed 1, 2, 3, 42 and 1234. The median of those 15 lap times is between 48 and 56 seconds. On every one of those runs the car's centre is never on grass, its footprint never touches a prop, and it is never stuck (slow for the bot's stuck threshold).
Six-car bot races on Hay Loop with seeds 1–5 all finish, with every car's 3 laps done within 5 minutes of sim time and no car ever stuck.

Around Hay Loop's hairpin (the 150° turn from AC2), the layout has at least 6 hay bales on the inside of the turn and at least 6 tyre stacks on the outside, each centred within 5 units of the track edge. No prop's centre is closer to the centreline than half the width + 1.

At least 8 of Hay Loop's cone trees lie in the infield, inside the closed centreline loop and off the ribbon. The race scene built from Hay Loop's layout lists hay-bale, tyre-stack and cone-tree props and its one ramp in its prop cells, with per-kind counts equal to the layout's.

playtest.whatYoullSee: A new third track, Hay Loop. It's a long dirt course with a wavy S-bend and a tight hairpin loop at the far end, ringed by hay bales on the inside and tyre stacks on the outside. Cone trees fill the middle and there's a jump on the back straight. A lap takes the AI cars a little under a minute.
howToTest: Open the preview on your phone and press RACE (this is Bramble Bends).
Finish the race, then press NEXT RACE on the results screen (this is Dust Bowl).
Finish that race and press NEXT RACE again: the results and track name should now say Hay Loop.
Drive a lap: check for the S-bend, the jump on the back straight, and the tight hairpin loop with hay bales on its inside and tyre stacks on its outside.
Check that cone trees fill the middle of the track, that the minimap shows the whole loop, and that all six cars finish 3 laps.
